_about: Candidate profiles curated by hand in the admin dashboard (Firestore, edited Mar 8-9, 2026) for people who are NOT currently on any ballot in MyBallot's data. Their 2026 U.S. House primaries were suspended after Louisiana v. Callais and moved to Nov 3 under a redrawn map, so their old district assignments no longer apply. Kept here so the names, party corrections and photos aren't lost. When a candidate's new race is verified from the SoS qualifying list, add them to that contest in a seed file and copy their photoUrl over. Not read by the pipeline.
